 Costco Announces Recall of Popular Kirkland Item in 12 States 
 Follow Food & Recipes View feed Costco Announces Recall of Popular Kirkland Item in 12 States 
 One batch of the whipped cream may contain “cleaning chemicals.”
 By Lisa Mulcahy Published: Nov 10, 2026 2:40 PM EST Save Article Share Article Costco We've been independently researching and testing products for over 120 years. If you buy through our links, we may earn a commission. Learn more about our review process. 
 2 min read Key Points 
 Alamance Foods recalled Kirkland Signature Real Heavy Whipped Cream sold at Costco between October 11-31, 2026, in 12 states.
 Consumers reported chemical taste and smell but no serious health effects requiring medical care have been documented so far.
 Affected customers can return the product to Costco for a full refund; look for 15 oz red and white cans with item code AC50 and best-by date of 04/02/2027 with timestamps 00:35–02:45.
 If you recently bought whipped cream at Costco for your Thanksgiving pies, here’s an important heads-up.
 On November 7, Alamance Foods announced that it’s issued a voluntary recall of Kirkland Signature Real Heavy Whipped Cream, which it manufactures. The recall is for one batch of the product because it may contain a small amount of a “cleaning chemical.”
 The whipped cream was sold between October 11, 2026 and October 31, 2026 at Costco stores in 12 states: Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Iowa, Illinois, Indiana, Missouri, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Wisconsin.
 Alamance Foods states that Costco members who bought this batch of cream experienced a chemical taste and smell, but that “no serious adverse effects requiring medical care have been reported.” The recall is currently listed by Costco; the FDA (Food and Drug Administration) has not posted a recall notice for this product.
 Recalled whipped cream 
 The cream is packaged in red and white cans. Here’s the information to look for on that label:
 Product name: Kirkland Signature Real Heavy Whipped Cream, 15 oz (425 g)
 Item: #1777000
 Case pack: 8CT/3PK
 Item code: AC50 
 Best If Used By: 04/02/2027 
 Timestamps affected on can: 00:35–02:45
 What to do if you have the recalled whipped cream 
 Don’t eat it. If you have eaten some of it, monitor yourself for any symptoms, and if you feel sick, contact your health care provider.
 Alamance Foods is informing Costco members via letter if records show that they or their add-on members bought the product. You can take the cream back to your local Costco for a full refund. If you have questions, issues, or concerns, email Alamance Foods at customer.care@alamancefood.com.
